description: Patients with pre-existing conditions have the right to the benefits of a free market, liberated healthcare system, and the government has taken this right away from them. We cannot trust a monolithic, government-controlled healthcare system to provide an adequate, sustainable solution for patients with pre-existing conditions. title: Patients with Pre-existing Conditions Have the Right to a Free Market Healthcare System
